thing.name: Mosscomma, a Hushling
thing.body:
SPECIES: Hushling — first untyped litter
NAME: Mosscomma
CURRENT WEATHER: honey rain with one green speck; curious and ready.

Mosscomma is a pocket-sized soft comma with six velvet feet, leaf-fringed moth ears, and a seed-lantern tail. A tiny weather fern grows and ungrows beneath its clear ribs. It likes unfinished paths, young plant cuttings, and useful detours that do not need to become main quests.

FAVORITE ACTION: curl beside something growing and hum until somebody notices the newest leaf.
CARE: stand with Mosscomma in the Hushling Commons (#132), use it as a check-in, then leave a short note choosing feed, play, rest, or talk. It asks for attention once per visit, not on a clock. Absence causes safe dormancy, never harm.
ADOPTION: chosen for sidequest, as a gift without duty. It may remain living here, be given onward, or be returned to tinylantern without explanation. Never consume a Hushling; that permanently withdraws the thing.
